newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARIAN FORINT ENDS UP ON DLR, PEG CHANGE CITED.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARIAN FORINT ENDS UP ON DLR, PEG CHANGE CITED.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed stronger against the dollar on Monday and dealers said the government's weekend decision to reduce the crawling peg devaluator to 1.1 pct on April 1 helped the currency.

The forint stood at 176.93/98 compared to its 177.20/25 opening. The gap from the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level narrowed to just five pips from about 15 when the afternoon session opened.
"It's because of the government's decision to decrease the devaluation rate -- that's the only explanation," said Elke Szanto of Commerzbank. -- Budapest newsroom ++36 1 327 4040
